connector.name: CellarTracker
connector.registryDescription: Read-only access to your CellarTracker wine cellar: inventory, drinking windows, purchases, notes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cellartracker-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the slavins-co account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CT_USERNAME
env.description: CellarTracker username. Optional at install: the setup-credentials tool can store login locally instead.

env.name: CT_PASSWORD
env.description: CellarTracker password. Optional at install: the setup-credentials tool can store login locally instead.
